title: Ticket state-transition recovery contract (current + allowed-next + intermediate states)
command: cargo test -p ticket-api --lib update_regression; cargo test -p ticket-cli --test integration_transition_recovery; cargo test -p ticket-mcp --test integration_update_mcp
detail: Verifies a blocked ticket transition (new -> in-implementation) is rejected with a recovery-oriented error naming the current state, allowed next states, and mandatory intermediate waypoints, across ticket-api/ticket-cli/ticket-mcp (HTTP inherits via Display). Also verifies the `transitions` inspection command.
